d.investigationBoundary: Same precise session/source only: logcat epoch->sourceUptime conversion, accepted-sequence temporal consistency, lease deadline monotonicity, controller time-window effects. Excludes public fallback/source-switch semantics, ingress overflow, presentation, restart recovery, device validation, and production writes.
d.dominantSuspectedLimitation: sourceUptime is wall-clock-derived and can regress independently of strictly increasing sample sequence; no authority guard prevents lease deadline regression or downstream regressing nowMs.
